description: Built late 1952; served with the 3 Regione Aerea at Bari as RB 40 then with the 2 Regione Aerea at Rome as RR 73; acquired in 1964 by the former Institute of Aeronautics of the University of Palermo; one of only five complete surviving G.59
museum_name: Museo Storico dei Motori e dei Meccanismi -- Palermo

description: Built by Aeritalia under Lockheed licence in the late 1970s and upgraded to ASA-M standard from 1997; retired in 2004 from 9 Stormo at Grazzanise; displayed on the University of Palermo campus since 2010 under Aeronautica Militare concession; completely repainted in original grey in February 2023 with support from 37 Stormo
museum_name: Museo Storico dei Motori e dei Meccanismi -- Palermo
